## Mexico Municipalities — Key Frame Map

This key frame establishes the geographic base for Mexico's 2,478 municipalities,
colored by state to distinguish the 32 federal entities. It serves as the spatial
foundation for subsequent data joins.

```{r load-packages}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
```

```{r load-shapefile}
# Read the municipality-level shapefile (Marco Geoestadístico Nacional, INEGI)
mun <- st_read("data/Mexico_mun_layer_simplified.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# Repair any invalid ring windings before dissolving
mun <- st_make_valid(mun)

# ── CRS: assert EPSG:6372 then transform (idempotent if already correct) ───────
mun <- st_transform(mun, 6372)
stopifnot("CRS must be EPSG:6372" = st_crs(mun)$epsg == 6372L)

# Dissolve municipalities → state boundaries for a stronger outline layer
states <- mun |>
  group_by(CVE_ENT) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r key-frame}
# ── Produce the CVEGEO key frame with municipality areas ──────────────────────
# st_area() returns m²; divide by 1e6 for km²
key_frame <- mun |>
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(CVEGEO, CVE_ENT, CVE_MUN, NOMGEO, area_km2)

stopifnot("key_frame must have 2478 rows"         = nrow(key_frame) == 2478L)
stopifnot("CVEGEO must be unique"                 = n_distinct(key_frame$CVEGEO) == 2478L)
stopifnot("No NA allowed in CVEGEO"               = sum(is.na(key_frame$CVEGEO)) == 0L)

cat("key_frame built:", nrow(key_frame), "rows ×", ncol(key_frame), "cols\n")
glimpse(key_frame)
```

```{r load-cross-section}
# ── Load cross-section: ENVIPE insecurity perception + Censo 2020 denominators
# Source: cs_municipal_2025_popweighted.csv
# NOTE: SESNSP homicide/robbery incidence counts are not yet in this file.
#       This CSV provides Censo denominators (pobtot_2020, p_18ymas_2020)
#       and ENVIPE-based perceived insecurity for criteria 1–2 scoring.
#       When SESNSP monthly CSVs land, collapse to 2025 totals and join here.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cs_raw <- read_csv("data/cs_municipal_2025_popweighted.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# CVEGEO in CSV is numeric (e.g. 1001); pad to 5-char string to match shapefile
cs_raw <- cs_raw |>
  mutate(CVEGEO = sprintf("%05d", CVEGEO))

# Drop the 8 ENVIPE aggregate/sentinel CVEGEOs that have no geometry
# (09998, 14998, 20999, 22998, 26998, 26999, 30998, 30999)
cs_sentinel <- cs_raw |> filter(!CVEGEO %in% key_frame$CVEGEO)
cs_clean    <- cs_raw |> filter( CVEGEO %in% key_frame$CVEGEO)

cat("CSV rows read:", nrow(cs_raw),
    "| sentinel rows dropped:", nrow(cs_sentinel),
    "| rows retained:", nrow(cs_clean), "\n")
if (nrow(cs_sentinel) > 0) {
  cat("Sentinel CVEGEOs:", paste(cs_sentinel$CVEGEO, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r load-sesnsp}
# ── Load SESNSP crime data: intentional homicide + robbery w/ violence ─────────
# Source: cs_municipal_2025.xlsx
# Columns used:
#   homicidio_doloso_prom_diario   — intentional homicide, daily avg (SESNSP 2025)
#   robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario — vehicle robbery w/ violence, daily avg (SESNSP 2025)
# Values are already aggregated daily averages; no further transformation applied.

sesnsp_raw <- read_excel("data/cs_municipal_2025.xlsx") |>
  rename(CVEGEO = cve_mun_completa) |>
  mutate(CVEGEO = sprintf("%05d", CVEGEO)) |>
  select(CVEGEO, homicidio_doloso_prom_diario, robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario)

# Drop the same 8 aggregate/sentinel CVEGEOs
sesnsp_sentinel <- sesnsp_raw |> filter(!CVEGEO %in% key_frame$CVEGEO)
sesnsp_clean    <- sesnsp_raw |> filter( CVEGEO %in% key_frame$CVEGEO)

cat("SESNSP rows read:", nrow(sesnsp_raw),
    "| sentinel rows dropped:", nrow(sesnsp_sentinel),
    "| rows retained:", nrow(sesnsp_clean), "\n")
```

```{r assemble-cross-section}
# ── Left-join key_frame ← ENVIPE/Censo ← SESNSP crime ─────────────────────────
cross_section <- key_frame |>
  left_join(cs_clean,     by = "CVEGEO") |>
  left_join(sesnsp_clean, by = "CVEGEO")

cat("cross_section assembled:", nrow(cross_section), "rows ×",
    ncol(cross_section), "cols\n")
```

```{r pipeline-key-audit}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PIPELINE KEY AUDIT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("1. KEY FRAME ROW / KEY CHECKS\n")
cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("  Rows:              ", nrow(key_frame), "(expected 2478)\n")
cat("  Unique CVEGEOs:    ", n_distinct(key_frame$CVEGEO), "\n")
cat("  NA in CVEGEO:      ", sum(is.na(key_frame$CVEGEO)), "\n")
cat("  Area NAs:          ", sum(is.na(key_frame$area_km2)), "\n")
cat("  Area range (km²):  ", round(min(key_frame$area_km2), 2), "–",
    round(max(key_frame$area_km2), 2), "\n\n")

cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("2. ENVIPE / CENSO JOIN COVERAGE\n")
cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
n_envipe <- sum(!is.na(cross_section$pct_inseguro_municipio))
n_pop_na <- sum(is.na(cross_section$pobtot_2020))
cat("  Municipios with ENVIPE data:    ", n_envipe, "/", nrow(cross_section), "\n")
cat("  Municipios missing pobtot_2020: ", n_pop_na, "\n\n")

cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("3. SESNSP CRIME DATA COVERAGE & DISTRIBUTION\n")
cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
n_hom_na  <- sum(is.na(cross_section$homicidio_doloso_prom_diario))
n_rob_na  <- sum(is.na(cross_section$robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario))
n_hom_pos <- sum(cross_section$homicidio_doloso_prom_diario > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_rob_pos <- sum(cross_section$robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("  Homicide (doloso) — NAs:", n_hom_na,
    "| municipios with events:", n_hom_pos, "/", nrow(cross_section), "\n")
cat("  Robbery (veh+violencia) — NAs:", n_rob_na,
    "| municipios with events:", n_rob_pos, "/", nrow(cross_section), "\n\n")
cat("  homicidio_doloso_prom_diario summary:\n")
print(summary(cross_section$homicidio_doloso_prom_diario))
cat("  robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario summary:\n")
print(summary(cross_section$robo_veh_violencia_prom_diario))

cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("AUDIT COMPLETE — pipeline status: COMPLETE\n")
cat("Key frame: ✓  |  ENVIPE/Censo join: ✓  |  SESNSP crime: ✓\n")
cat("────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
```

```{r key-frame-map, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
# ── Categorical palette: 8-hue fixed order, validated for CVD separation ──────
# Hues are cycled across 32 states (4 states per hue) using modular assignment
# so no two adjacent states share the same hue bucket where possible.
state_palette <- c(
  "#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#59A14F", "#E15759",
  "#76B7B2", "#EDC948", "#B07AA1", "#FF9DA7"
)

# Assign a display hue to each state using modulo cycling
mun <- mun |>
  mutate(hue_group = factor((as.integer(CVE_ENT) - 1L) %% 8L + 1L))

# ── Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Municipality fills — light alpha so boundaries remain legible
  geom_sf(
    data  = mun,
    aes(fill = hue_group),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.08,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # State outlines — drawn on top, no fill, clearly heavier stroke
  geom_sf(
    data      = states,
    fill      = NA,
    color     = "#1a1a1a",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  # Fixed 8-hue palette — same order every render, never cycled by rank
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_palette) +
  # ── Labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  labs(
    title    = "Mexico: Municipal Boundaries",
    subtitle = "2,478 municipalities across 32 states — key frame for spatial analysis",
    caption  = "Source: INEGI — Mexico_mun_layer_simplified shapefile\nProjection: Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC (EPSG:6372)"
  ) +
  # ── Theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "#555555", size = 10, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.caption    = element_text(color = "#888888", size = 8,  hjust = 0,
                                   margin = margin(t = 10)),
    plot.margin     = margin(12, 12, 12, 12),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```
